description: This file implements the RemoteSecureClock class, which provides remote secure clock functionalities such as generating timestamps, using Android's Keymaster and aidl interfaces.

classes.name: RemoteSecureClock
classes.description: A class that provides remote secure clock functionalities, including generating timestamps via a remote keymaster implementation.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp token using a challenge, interacting with the remote keymaster and returning the result or an error status.
